ValidationRule.description: BOPI-525 Opportunity Type can't be 'New' if contract is renewed or amended
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", OR( NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__RenewedContract__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__AmendedContract__c)) ), ISPICKVAL(Type,"New Business") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity Type can't be 'New' if contract is renewed or amended
